# 14-section calc chrome (locked)

Order is locked. Safety stays visible under the lede **and** on the result card. Results win by **size**, not a second hue. Fret print is **light only**.

Reconstructed from the starred token / kickoff lock notes in this repo. Full Phase 2 prototype chrome stays on Origin until the zip lands.

| # | id | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `family` | Lane eyebrow — Audio / live sound or Guitar building |
| 2 | `title` | Tool name |
| 3 | `lede` | One-paragraph purpose |
| 4 | `safety-lede` | Safety / verify well **under the lede** (always visible) |
| 5 | `inputs` | Numeric fields |
| 6 | `units` | Unit, temperature, temperament toggles |
| 7 | `presets` | Example-lock chips (do not invent extra marketing CTAs) |
| 8 | `compute` | Implicit live calc or explicit Calculate |
| 9 | `result` | Primary numeral — `--result`, `clamp(2.5rem, 8vw, 4rem)` |
| 10 | `safety-result` | Safety echo **on the result card** |
| 11 | `breakdown` | Path table or fret table |
| 12 | `verify` | Pass / warn chip — lime `--ok` for Pass only |
| 13 | `formula` | Show-your-work (mono) |
| 14 | `print` | Export; fret uses `--print-bg` / `--print-text` / `--print-rule` only |

Related-tool chips and site header/footer sit **outside** this 14.

See `shared/calc-shell.ts` for the typed section list.
